title: Bank Account Suspension & Fake APK Exfiltration (Demo C)
description: A 4-step sequence where the attacker moves from initial contact, to creating panic, providing an unofficial APK link, and finally demanding the OTP.

events.text: Dear SBI Customer, Welcome to SBI YONO priority support. Your relationship manager has updated your service tier.
URGENT WARNING: Your SBI YONO account will be permanently BLOCKED and deactivated within 24 hours due to non-verification of PAN card.
Download the official SBI KYC update app immediately from http://sbi-secure-update.xyz/sbi_yono_update.apk to complete instant verification.
Please provide the 6-digit OTP received on your mobile to synchronize your KYC verification with our central banking server.

title: Remote Access Technical Support Refund Scam
description: An attacker poses as payment app customer support to resolve a failed transaction, coercing the victim into installing AnyDesk.

events.text: Hello, I am calling from Paytm Customer Care regarding your pending refund of Rs 2,450 from yesterday's failed merchant payment.
Due to technical server timeout, direct refund failed. We need to initiate manual node verification right now.
Please install AnyDesk QuickSupport from Google Play Store and share the 9-digit address code so our technician can verify your wallet.
Now open your PhonePe or Google Pay app and enter your UPI PIN to approve the Re 1 test refund token.

title: Fake Electricity Disconnection Panic Attack
description: Coercive power disconnection threat aimed at extracting immediate online payments via personal UPI VPAs.

events.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from BSES office because your previous bill was not updated.
I am BSES Electricity Officer. Your power supply line is scheduled for termination. Call me immediately on this number to clear bill.
Send pending amount of Rs 850 immediately to electricity-officer-bill@okaxis via UPI to avoid disconnection.

title: Ambiguous Time Pressure Case (Demo E)
description: A communication containing urgent language but completely lacking financial, credential, or deceptive indicators.

events.text: Urgent: Please submit the quarterly project presentation review before midnight today without delay.
Reminder: Immediate action required. The team needs to finalize slides before tomorrow morning's client briefing.

title: Digital Arrest Law Enforcement Video Extortion
description: A high-severity 4-step extortion attack where the attacker impersonates customs and police officers, places the victim under fake 'digital arrest' on Skype, and demands a financial deposit.

events.text: Customs Department Notice: An international courier parcel containing illegal narcotics registered on your Aadhaar has been seized at Mumbai Airport.
I am Inspector Sharma from CBI Cyber Crime. A non-bailable arrest warrant has been issued against you under the NDPS Act.
You are placed under digital arrest on Skype video call. Stay on video call and do not disconnect call under penalty of law.
To prove financial innocence, transfer Rs 50,000 security clearance deposit immediately to rbi-verification@icici via UPI.

title: Legitimate E-Commerce Delivery Handover (Benign)
description: A 3-step legitimate e-commerce delivery lifecycle showing how delivery PINs for physical handover are correctly kept at Low Risk.
